events.summary: Baseline review of Bridge Builder 0.1.0: exact package bytes, library.suggest descriptor, no requested permissions, deterministic two-sided Flow compatibility fixture and privacy source policy were checked.
limitations: Bridge suggestions require Flow analysis for both seed tracks and candidate tracks.
A high bridge score means the local features fit the reference transition heuristic; it is not a guarantee that a human listener will prefer the transition.
Melodex does not broker local paths or raw audio to the plugin, but extension subprocesses are not yet protected by a complete OS sandbox.
